verdict.rationale: Clara documents one narrow native rule that fires automatically on an event: cards set with a period end date and `enableAutoDeletion: true` are deleted when that date arrives. Its homepage also claims "automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance" without describing any configurable rules. Webhook subscriptions are only a building block for user-built automation, and card restrictions and limit resets are adjacent spend controls, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: a general user-definable event→action rule engine, documented trigger and action types beyond card auto-deletion, any detail behind the approval/compliance automation claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
